shortDescription: Jeep-parent Stellantis MIL:STLAM said on Monday it will sell its idled assembly plant in Brampton, Canada to defense technology firm Roshel for an undisclosed amount.Stellantis had been locked in a dispute with Canadian union Unifor over the fate of Brampton workers.Here are some more details:

children: said on Monday it will sell its idled assembly plant in Brampton, Canada to defense technology firm Roshel for an undisclosed amount.
Stellantis had been locked in a dispute with Canadian union Unifor over the fate of Brampton workers.

Stellantis closed the Brampton plant in 2023 for retooling, but paused the work in 2025 before moving future production of its Jeep Compass to a factory in Illinois after US President Donald Trump imposed tariffs on Canadian goods.
Canada's industry minister Mélanie Joly said the sale does not erase Stellantis' commitment to workers
"After three years of paid layoff, we remain committed to working with Unifor on a fair resolution," said Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa
However, Unifor's National President Lana Payne said Stellantis had "betrayed" its members with "an underhanded deal to sell the plant and walk away from its commitments to our members"
Joly said she planned to convene a meeting this week with Unifor, Stellantis, Ontario government and the Brampton plant workers
